column47: Scientific Reports: from mid-September 2026, PubMed has paused adding new Scientific Reports articles while the National Library of Medicine re-evaluates the journal ([Retraction Watch, 30 Oct 2026](https://retractionwatch.com/2026/10/30/scientific-reports-pubmed-on-hold-national-library-medicine-evaluation/)). Counts from August on are incomplete; the journal published about 4,200 articles a month in this period.
